name: 妮科尔·法尔塞蒂
name_full: 妮科尔·法尔塞蒂 Nicole Falsetti
introduction: With over a decade of Hollywood experience, Nicole has most recently written for Marvel’s upcoming TV Show, VisionQuest, and has worked on projects for Netflix, Disney and Paramount.Nicole loves blending her passion for Sci-Fi and Fantasy into compelling romance narratives with strong female leads at the helm.When she's not lost in a world of words, Nicole can be found with her nose in a book, traveling to new places, practicing mindfulness or hitting the trails with her intrepid dog, Milo.
